content:
Today marks the completion of One month of daily blogging as part of the Post A Day 2011 challenge.
Its been really nice for me, like a new good habit of writing daily. I’ve posted partly from my laptop and partly from my cellphone, but one is for sure, every word came from the heart, no conceit here whatsoever.
I think this is the beauty of blogging, which so different from something like fakebook, sorry, facebook. People in the blogosphere write to express themselves, without concern for the reactions of a hundred people, who dont really care what you feel.
Blogging for me, has turned from a hobby to a habit, and I like that. :)
